title: Spatial transcriptomics of human meningioma samples

publications.title: Spatially resolved single-cell analyses of human meningioma identify novel cell states influencing tumor microenvironment and progression.

institution: University Health Network / University of Toronto
platform: Illumina NovaSeq X (10x Genomics Visium HD)
needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-11), from a discovery-log LEAD flagging this as possibly the spatial component of the same project/paper as EGAS50000001589 ('A single-cell atlas of meningioma'), released the same week. Independently verified live via the EGA Metadata API: study EGAS50000001556 ('Spatial transcriptomics of human meningioma samples') / dataset EGAD50000002233, num_samples=43, technologies 'Illumina NovaSeq X', same policy_accession_id (EGAP00001001109) as EGAS50000001589/EGAD50000002272. Fetched this dataset's 43 registered EGAN sample accessions directly: subject IDs run MNG095 through MNG137, phenotype 'tumor' for all, sex 33 female/10 male. This subject ID range is the EXACT continuation of EGAS50000001589's registered snRNA-seq arm (which covers MNG001-MNG094), with zero overlapping subject IDs between the two datasets, and 43 matches precisely the 'n=43 samples, 7,146,538 segmented cells' spatial-arm figure quoted in EGAD50000002272's own description. CONCLUSION: this is genuinely part of the SAME overarching flagship 'single-cell atlas of meningioma' project (same DAC/policy, same release week, sequential patient numbering scheme) but registered as its own separate EGA study/dataset accession, using a DIFFERENT, non-overlapping subset of 43 patients than the 94-patient snRNA-seq arm. Per instructions, this is therefore extracted as a STANDALONE record (not merged, not a duplicate) and cross-linked via related_accessions/paired_multimodal.related_datasets to egas50000001589-atlas-snrna-spatial; the reverse cross-link (egas50000001589-atlas-snrna-spatial.json listing this record in its related_accessions/related_datasets) has already been added there, but that other file was not edited by this process beyond what was written when it was newly created in this same batch -- flagging here for visibility since a parallel batch may also touch that file. paired_multimodal.is_paired set to false (not multi_modal_matched) because the two arms use disjoint patient cohorts, not the same patients profiled by two modalities. cell_count_post_qc (7,146,538) is described in the source as 'segmented cells' from Visium HD spot/cell segmentation, not classic scRNA-seq QC-filtered cell count; recorded here with that caveat, Medium confidence. No linked publication (pubmed_ids empty). Only public EGA study/dataset/sample-level metadata was used per docs/scope.md; the controlled-access spatial data itself was never accessed. tags.large_cohort left false pending centralized post-hoc recomputation. PUBLICATION LINKED (2026-07-13), prompted by a user question about whether a paper's data-availability statement was fully represented here: Landry et al. 2026 (Nature Genetics, PMID 42265312, DOI 10.1038/s41588-026-02615-w) cites 'EGAD50000002233 for Visium HD data' verbatim in its data-availability section (confirmed by fetching the paper's own full-text XML), matching this record's own Visium HD platform and 7,146,538-segmented-cell figure. corresponding_author inferred from Nassiri/Zadeh's last-author position, consistent with this lab's other records; no explicit corresponding-author footnote was found in the fetched XML, so kept at Medium confidence.
